### [Practitioner Exchange](practitioner-exchange.qmd)

A facilitation retreat for wellness, bodymind and movement practitioners. Each
participant leads a session in their own modality and receives feedback from
peers.

Tentatively May 2027 · Germany · in English

::: {.item}
### [Moving Together](moving-together.qmd)

A movement retreat: yoga, tantra and improvised movement, side by side, in pairs
and as a whole group. No experience needed.

Tentatively September 2027 · Germany · in English
